:::{#exr-bernoulli-sample-mean-deviation}
#### Sample mean of the deviations of a binary sample

In the setting of @exr-bernoulli-score-contribution, let:

- $\outbar \eqdef \avgin \outvar_\iobs$ be the [sample mean](exploratory-descriptive.qmd#def-sample-mean) of the observed outcomes;
- $\smeandev \eqdef \avgin \devn_\iobs$ be the sample mean of the [deviations](https://morrison-lab.github.io/pds/variance-covariance.html#def-deviation-pop-mean) $\devn_\iobs$.

Write $\smeandev$ using $\outbar$ and $\prob$.

:::

{{< slidebreak >}}

:::{#sol-bernoulli-sample-mean-deviation}

$$
\begin{aligned}
\smeandev
&= \avgin \devn_\iobs
&& \text{(definition of $\smeandev$)}\\
&= \avgin (\outvar_\iobs - \prob)
&& \text{(definition of $\devn_\iobs$)}\\
&= \frac{1}{n} \paren{\sumin \outvar_\iobs - \sumin \prob}
&& \text{(distribute the sum over the difference)}\\
&= \frac{1}{n} \paren{\sumof{\vy} - \sumin \prob}
&& \text{(definition of $\sumof{\vy}$)}\\
&= \frac{1}{n} \paren{n \outbar - n \prob}
&& \text{($\sumof{\vy} = n \outbar$ and $\textstyle\sumin \prob = n \prob$)}\\
&= \frac{1}{n} \cdot n (\outbar - \prob)
&& \text{(factor out $n$)}\\
&= \outbar - \prob
&& \text{($\frac{1}{n} \cdot n = 1$)}
\end{aligned}
$$

:::
